data.why: The repo already bundles example_a370/ (FITS target field + catalog + APT plan) and example_r0600/ (JPG+WCS-sidecar + catalog) at the repo root; the app's 'Load Abell 370 example' / 'Load RXCJ0600 example' buttons find them automatically via the source-checkout path, so nothing needs to be copied or written.

goals: Load a target-field image (FITS or JPG+WCS) and see the NIRSpec MSA quadrants overlaid at a chosen pointing and roll angle
Run the pointing optimizer to find the RA/Dec/V3-PA that places the most (or highest-priority) catalog sources into operable shutters
Hand-pick shutters on the image with live feedback on which picks would create spectral overlap (masked/conflict) with other sources or stuck-open shutters
Protect select high-priority targets so no other spectrum can contaminate theirs, and verify the optimizer and hand-picks respect that
Save a session and/or export an APT-importable catalog + MPT plan bundle that reproduces the exact shutter configuration
Load an existing APT MPT plan or saved vMPT session back in to continue or review someone else's shutter picks

review.summary: The tree correctly frames vMPT as placing the NIRSpec micro-shutter array, optimizing the pointing, hand-picking shutters with overlap feedback and exporting to APT, and most cited screens match their nodes. It needs fixes before filing: the optimizer and collision-protection evidence rests on a catalog built from the agent's own picks even though the repo bundles a real Abell 370 catalog, the disperser and multi-configuration stages are missing, and the overlap colour meanings are partly mislabeled.
